text:
The City of Masks
Thrilling and dangerous encounters in
Slums and soaring towers, castles and canals, crowded city 
streets! The City of Masks is a place of intrigue and danger 
where the next hooded figure might be a masked sorcerer of 
The Shroud, a Thieves' Guild thug, or even the Duke himself! 
‡Poor: Gutterwash, Rilken Row
†Working: Silvertop, The Rooks
*Wealthy: Montmar Castle, Gedgarrin, High Harbor, Ninestones
